articles.title: Qatar’s $5.5 million startup fund could open doors for African founders
articles.summary: Qatar is offering foreign tech startups up to $5.5 million in funding, alongside residency and relocation support, as it seeks to attract entrepreneurs to Doha. African founders could benefit from the programme, but accessing the funding comes with conditions, and Qatar's startup ecosystem is still developing.

articles.title: Nigeria’s crypto firms face $744,000 capital rule as CBN, SEC divide oversight
articles.summary: The framework draws a clearer regulatory boundary for crypto businesses that combine trading with payments, requiring companies operating across both markets to secure authorisation from each regulator. It also raises compliance costs, prohibiting firms from counting the same capital toward their CBN and SEC requirements.
